description.narrative: Providing school uniforms and school bags for Yemeni children: to support the continuation of education for 11,586 beneficiary children. Rehabilitation and improvement of the infrastructure for 23 schools in the governorates of Yemen (Hadhramaut, Al-Mahra, Aden, Hajjah) affected by conflict and natural disasters in order to ensure that students have access to the educational environment in Yemen.

The Education Support Project in Yemen aims to increase access to basic and secondary education for Yemeni students, improve learning conditions, and enhance the capabilities of the education sector by reducing the dropout rate of students from schools and providing them with a safe study environment.

• Increasing access to basic and secondary education, improving learning conditions, and enhancing the capacity of the education sector in the project's target areas. • Ensure the access of students affected by the conflict to basic educational services. • Raising the level of stability of the educational process and ensuring the achievement of the study plan of the Ministry of Education.
